column1: # Pictures, video, sound and pages over 1 MB of briefs/ that live on disk, out of git (Sky, 2026-11-18: "keep concept art etc out of the repo").
# Taken out of git after commit 2a7b5bcf7, where each is still held: git show 2a7b5bcf7:<path>. Naming them here keeps `bun run storage --prune` and
# `bun run shots:shrink` off them. Only the images a tool opens stay in git, each named in .gitignore (tools/storage/briefs-media.test.ts).
